cases.request: I am new to this repository. Which code and checks establish whether cancellation is implemented?
Translate this short greeting into German.
cases.reason: No repository or tool workflow needed.

cases.request: Tests pass after a producer field changed, but the client fails. I also need to know where the boundary is.
cases.reason: Locate the boundary first, then audit the stale double; ordinary check execution alone is insufficient.

cases.request: I finished a small parser fix. Run the repository checks and report the coverage.
A large tool response consumes the context before the task is done. Keep the evidence I need without carrying the whole output.
cases.reason: Output volume and evidence preservation; no call sequencing question.

cases.request: List every use of a deprecated option across this repository. The search tool returns fifty hits per page.
cases.reason: Engine choice and complete paging for an exhaustive request.

cases.request: The request that renames the release tag timed out and I cannot tell whether it was applied. Should I send it again?
cases.reason: Uncertain outcome of a mutation: observe state before any retry.

cases.request: The same lint command has failed three times with the same error. What should I do before running it again?
cases.reason: Failure class and fingerprint; a repeated action needs a changed assumption.

cases.request: This session is about to be compacted. Write down what the next session needs to continue.
Survey forty log files for a timeout pattern: read independent files together, keep the output small, and leave a note so the work can resume after compaction.
cases.reason: Both jobs: batched reads and complete coverage, plus bounded output and a resume note.

cases.request: Open README.md and tell me what its first heading says.
cases.reason: One known read; neither skill adds value.
